entities.name: Oret
entities.description: In this alternate timeline, a Dromoka cartographer for Commander Faiso and cousin of Anafenza, who executes her on his dragon's command and later keeps her spirit alive.

entities.name: Anafenza
entities.description: A Dromoka captain in the alternate timeline who calls ancestor spirits from a kin-tree, defeats a Kolaghan horde, and is executed for necromancy.

entities.name: Gvar Barzeel
entities.description: The Kolaghan orc who led the attack on Sandsteppe Gateway and is killed by Anafenza's ancestor spirits.

entities.name: Commander Faiso
entities.description: A human Dromoka commander respected by Dromoka, whom Oret serves as cartographer.

entities.name: Dromoka
entities.description: The dragonlord of the Dromoka clan whose law forbids necromancy.

entities.name: Oret's scalelord
entities.description: The Dromoka scalelord to whom Oret is bonded, who allows him to execute Anafenza after discovering her necromancy.

entities.name: Yeffa
entities.description: A broad veteran soldier and storyteller who witnessed the Guardian on the battlefield.

entities.name: Ajuf
entities.description: A youthful soldier who wants to hear stories of the Guardian.

entities.name: Khurz
entities.description: A skeptical soldier who doubts Oret's story.

entities.name: Taram
entities.description: A gaunt, sun-bronzed soldier who dislikes talk of spirits and leaves.

entities.name: The Guardian
entities.description: A ghostly woman soldier made of sand said to save Dromoka soldiers, whom Oret identifies as Anafenza.

entities.name: Dromoka clan
entities.description: The clan of the dragonlord Dromoka, whose army includes ainok, humans, and aven.

entities.name: Kolaghan clan
entities.description: A lightning-using clan that raids Dromoka territory.

entities.name: Sandsteppe Gateway
entities.description: A Dromoka fortress that Gvar stormed with Kolaghan dragons overhead.

entities.name: Kavah
entities.description: A city where Oret was welcomed as a hero after executing Anafenza.

entities.name: Kin-tree
entities.description: A twisted tree in a canyon chamber carved with names, anchoring the spirits of ancestors bound in amber; it is later splintered, and Oret plants a new one.

entities.name: Canyon chamber
entities.description: A dead-end chamber in a canyon where Anafenza's last stand takes place.

events.summary: At a military camp, soldiers argue about the Guardian, a spirit said to fight for Dromoka troops; Oret says he can tell them who she is.
events.quote: I'm the one who killed that spirit in life.

events.summary: In the flashback, Oret and Captain Anafenza flee a Kolaghan horde through a canyon after their fortress falls and their lines break.
events.quote: But here they were, their fortress lost and their lines broken, fleeing for their lives before the bulk of a Kolaghan horde.

events.summary: A Kolaghan orc kills Oret's ibex with a lightning spear and attacks him; Anafenza kills the orc by drawing out his life with golden-white light.
events.quote: It passed through him, pulling something unseen but vital from him as it passed, leaving him lifeless in the dust.

events.summary: Anafenza leads Oret to a kin-tree in a dead-end chamber, revealing that amber vessels and the carved tree anchor ancestor spirits.
events.quote: Spirits can be carried in amber, but I believe the tree is their anchor.

events.summary: Gvar Barzeel and dozens of Kolaghan warriors enter the chamber, and Anafenza calls on the tree's ancestors.
events.quote: Spirits of this tree, ancestors of my people, your descendants need you.

events.summary: Anafenza merges with the ancestor spirits and kills Gvar and his entire warband.
events.quote: Gvar, the shamans, all of the Kolaghan raiders—they didn't stand a chance.

events.summary: A dragon of Kolaghan's brood dives at Anafenza and is torn apart by a bolt of golden light made of spirits, while the rest flee.
events.quote: They moved as a massive bolt of golden light, and at its advance the dragon tried to reverse course.

events.summary: Oret's scalelord lands in the chamber, crushing the kin-tree and learning of Anafenza's necromancy.
events.quote: their scalelord descended into the chamber where, beneath its great weight, the ancient tree fell to splinters.

events.summary: Oret asks his scalelord to let him execute Anafenza himself, and the dragon agrees.
events.quote: Please, my scalelord, allow me to be the one to execute her.

events.summary: Oret beheads Anafenza as she kneels, whispering that it is not the end.
events.quote: This is not the end," he whispered to his captain.

events.summary: Oret is honored in Kavah, then secretly gathers the amber shards and plants a new tree with Anafenza's name carved in it, erasing it from maps so her spirit has an anchor.
events.quote: It was to be Anafenza's tree.

events.summary: Oret reveals he now travels the Dromoka lands to tell the truth of the Guardian.
events.quote: I now travel our territory to share the truth. She is, as Yeffa said, a guardian.

relations.note: Anafenza is both his captain and his cousin.
relations.quote: His captain—his cousin—was going to die there.

relations.note: He executes her with her own sword after his scalelord assents.
relations.quote: A moment later, it was done.
He was a cartographer for Commander Faiso

relations.note: He is bonded to the dragon.
relations.quote: Oret saw him, his scalelord, the dragon to whom he was bonded.

relations.note: Her ancestral spirits slay Gvar's warband.
relations.quote: Gvar, the shamans, all of the Kolaghan raiders—they didn't stand a chance.
Gvar, the orc who led the attack on Sandsteppe Gateway.

relations.note: She served as a Dromoka captain.
relations.quote: armed and armored as a Dromoka soldier

relations.note: Oret identifies the spirit as Anafenza.
relations.quote: She is, as Yeffa said, a guardian.
